path = File.join(Gem.loaded_specs.fetch('rubocop').full_gem_path, 'config/default.yml')
value = YAML.respond_to?(:unsafe_load_file) ? YAML.unsafe_load_file(path) : YAML.load_file(path)
value['Layout/LineLength']['Max'] = 10
RuboCop::ConfigLoader.default_configuration = RuboCop::Config.new(value, path)

require 'lint_roller'
module RuboCop; module Cop; module Probe; class PluginCop < Base; end; end; end; end
class ProbePlugin < LintRoller::Plugin
  def about
    LintRoller::About.new(name: 'probe-plugin', version: '1.0')
  end
  def rules(context)
    LintRoller::Rules.new(type: :object, config_format: :rubocop, value: {'Layout/LineLength'=>{'Max'=>10}, 'Probe/PluginCop'=>{'Enabled'=>false}})
  end
end
spec = Gem::Specification.new { |s| s.name='probe-plugin'; s.version='1.0'; s.metadata['default_lint_roller_plugin']='ProbePlugin' }
Gem.loaded_specs['probe-plugin']=spec
